test_title: PYST 29: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight friends, Arvind, Priya, Kunal, Kajal, Ashish, Mahak, Shubham and Riddhi are sitting around an octagonal table, facing the centre. Kunal is between Mahak and Ashish. Kajal is between Priya and Arvind. Shubham is to the immediate left of Riddhi. Arvind is third to the right of Ashish. Who is sitting between Riddhi and Priya?
solution:
Eight friends, Arvind, Priya, Kunal, Kajal, Ashish, Mahak, Shubham and Riddhi are sitting around an octagonal table, facing the centre.

2) Arvind is third to the right of Ashish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d664afadb1f10b916993805d8226ae18a38509a20244f417ceb357b3f9eaf0c.png] 

3) Kajal is between Priya and Arvind.

Case (i) :

4) Kunal is between Mahak and Ashish.

Case (i) :

5) Shubham is to the immediate left of Riddhi.

Case (i) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/736905ee5b4f0ee2d2feff4a09fd0aaffebb31211a73bb959cc59c9cdaa486f4.png] 

Case (ii) :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49fb88399fcf44948593f13aa8d172757c3a50735a65b7fdb8b3a9b1da24e3c5.png] 

From case (ii) of step 5 the seating position between Riddhi and Priya is obtained.

∴ Here, 'Shubham' is sitting between Riddhi and Priya.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Shubham".**
